macros.name: afunctionhead
macros.doc: Starts a ‘function definition’ subsubclause.

macros.name: altemail
macros.doc: Contact information for the document editor.

macros.name: altfax
macros.doc: Contact information for the document editor.

macros.name: anentityhead
macros.doc: Starts an ‘entity definition’ subsubclause.

macros.name: arulehead
macros.doc: Starts a ‘rule definition’ subsubclause.

macros.name: aschemaidhead
macros.doc: The command \aschemaidhead{<schema name>} prints the heading for a particular schema identification subsubclause.

macros.name: atypehead
macros.doc: Starts a ‘type definition’ subsubclause.

macros.name: B
macros.doc: \B{⟨text⟩} prints ⟨text⟩ in bold while \E{⟨text⟩} prints it emphasized.

macros.name: ballotcycle
macros.doc: The command \ballotcycle{<number >} is used to specify the ballot cycle number for the document (e.g., \ballotcycle{2}).

macros.name: bibidefix
macros.doc: The commands \bibidefix and \bibieeedefix produce the reference entry to the original FIPS version of IDEF1X and the IEEE version of IDEF1X respectively.

macros.name: bibidefo
macros.doc: The command \bibidefo produces the reference entry to the IDEF0 document and \brefidefo can be used for citing the reference in the body of the document.

macros.name: brefidefix
macros.doc: The command \brefidefix can be used for citing an IDEF1X reference in the body of the document.

macros.name: docidhead
macros.doc: The command \docidhead prints the heading for the document identification subclause.

macros.name: docreg
macros.doc: The command \docreg{<version no>} produces the boilerplate for document registration.

macros.name: doctitle
macros.doc: The command \doctitle{<informal title>} is used to specify the title to be used on the cover sheet.

macros.name: draftctr
macros.doc: The macro \draftctr generates boilerplate that may be used in the ‘Comments to Reader’ section of a cover page.

macros.name: endForeword
macros.doc: The Foreword clause is ended by the \endForeword{<norm annexes>}{<inf annexes>} command.

macros.name: entityhead
macros.doc: Starts an ‘entity definition’ subclause or an ‘entity definitions’ subclause.

macros.name: expressgdef
macros.doc: The \expressgdef prints the boilerplate for where the definition of EXPRESS-G can be found.

macros.name: expressghead
macros.doc: The command \expressghead prints the heading for the EXPRESS-G diagrams annex.

macros.name: expurls
macros.doc: The command \expurls{⟨short⟩}{⟨express⟩} prints the boilerplate for an annex of short names and EXPRESS schemas, where ⟨short⟩ is the URL of the short names and ⟨express⟩ is the URL of the EXPRESS code.

macros.name: fcandasubhead
macros.doc: Starts a ‘Fundamental concepts and assumptions’ subclause.

macros.name: Foreword
macros.doc: The \Foreword command specifies that a table of contents, list of figures and a list of tables be produced.

macros.name: fwdshortlist
macros.doc: The \fwdshortlist command produces boilerplate text for inclusion in the foreword referencing the STEP parts and series.

macros.name: haspatentstrue
macros.doc: The command \haspatentstrue shall be put in the preamble when the document includes identified patented material; otherwise the command \haspatentsfalse may, but need not, be used instead.

macros.name: introsubhead
macros.doc: Starts an ‘Introduction’ subclause.

macros.name: ixent
macros.doc: The command \ixent{<entity>} generates an index entry for the entity <entity>.

macros.name: listingshead
macros.doc: The command \listingshead prints the heading for the computer interpretable listings annex.

macros.name: majorsubname
macros.doc: Boilerplate for introduction to major subdivision listing.

macros.name: mapspectrue
macros.doc: The command \mapspectrue shall be put in the preamble if the AP uses a mapping specification rather than a mapping table.

macros.name: maptableorspec
macros.doc: Depending on \ifmapspec, prints either ‘table’ or ‘specification’.

macros.name: mnote
macros.doc: The command \mnote{<Marginal note text>} prints its parameter as a marginal note.

macros.name: objreghead
macros.doc: The command \objreghead prints the heading for the information object registration annex.

macros.name: partno
macros.doc: The command \partno{<number >} is used to specify the Part number of the ISO 10303 standard (e.g., \partno{3456}).

macros.name: picshead
macros.doc: The command \picshead, from the step package, prints the heading for the PICS annex.

macros.name: schemahead
macros.doc: The command \schemahead{<schema name>} prints the heading for a schema clause.

macros.name: schemaidhead
macros.doc: The command \schemaidhead prints the heading for the schema identification subclause.

macros.name: schemaintro
macros.doc: The command \schemaintro{<schema name>} produces the boilerplate for the introduction to an EXPRESS schema clause.

macros.name: schemareg
macros.doc: The command \schemareg{<version no>}{<p2 >}{<p3 >}{<p4 >}{<p5 >}{<p6 >} produces the boilerplate concerning schema registration.

macros.name: series
macros.doc: The command \series{<series title>} is used to specify the name of the ISO 10303 series of which the Part is a member (e.g., \series{application modules}).

macros.name: shortnamehead
macros.doc: The command \shortnamehead prints the heading for the short names annex.

macros.name: shortnames
macros.doc: The command \shortnames produces the boilerplate for the introduction to the annex listing short names.

macros.name: singlerulehead
macros.doc: Starts a ‘rule definition’ or ‘rule definitions’ subclause.

macros.name: singletypehead
macros.doc: Starts a ‘type definition’ or ‘type definitions’ subclause.

macros.name: STEPcover
macros.doc: The command \STEPcover{<commands>} produces a cover page for a STEP document.

macros.name: stepparttitle
macros.doc: The \stepparttitle{<part title>} command produces the title for an ISO 10303 part, where <part title> is the title of the part.

macros.name: steptrid
macros.doc: The \steptrid command produces boilerplate text for inclusion in the foreword describing the creators of a STEP Technical Report.

macros.name: techdischead
macros.doc: Starts a ‘Technical discussions’ informative annex.

envs.name: attrlist
envs.doc: The attrlist environment produces the heading for attribute definitions and sets up a description list.

envs.name: dtext
envs.doc: The dtext environment may be used to anonymously enclose descriptive text.

envs.name: ecode
envs.doc: The ecode environment is for tagging EXPRESS code.

envs.name: espec
envs.doc: The environment \begin{espec}{<name>} may be used to enclose, and give a name to, a complete specification block for an EXPRESS entity.

envs.name: Introduction
envs.doc: The \begin{Introduction} environment starts a new unnumbered clause entitled Introduction and adds some boilerplate text specifically for ISO 10303.

envs.name: majorsublist
envs.doc: The majorsublist environment prints the boilerplate for the heading of a listing of major subdivisions of the standard and starts an itemized list.
